studio.quickShape.title: Smart Shape
studio.quickShape.description.active: Draw line/oval/triangle/circle and it will refine into a clean shape.
studio.quickShape.description.inactive: It’s okay to rough sketch. When enabled, it converts hand drawing into clean shape strokes.
studio.quickShape.toggleHint: Hand-drawn shape snaps into a clean form the moment you lift the pen. A preview appears even if you pause briefly.
studio.quickShape.matchedSuffix: looks like this · finalize when you release
studio.quickShape.emptyStatus: Draw and release, or pause briefly at the end to preview.
studio.quickShape.notice: Hand-drawn shape refines into clean lines/ovals/rectangles when you release. Pause briefly to preview.
